title: Missing Tool Result Block in API Request
body:
**Bug Description**
 API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.224: Did not find 1 `tool_result` block(s) at the beginning of this 
message. Messages following `tool_use` blocks must begin with a matching number of `tool_result` blocks."}}


**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.9
